items.title: AxoSim and AxoBench
items.summary: AxoSim replaces detailed neuron simulations with learned models connected through explicit synapses, so one RTX 5090 simulates 65,536 neurons with 4,000 contacts each at 3.38× real-time speed. AxoBench provides datasets and metrics for such models, on single neurons and in recurrent circuits.

items.title: Improved Elastic Weight Consolidation
items.summary: IEWC derives EWC from an explicit constraint that preserves learned behavior, separating EWC's loss-gradient weighting from parameter sensitivity. Its variants improve on EWC in classification, segmentation, and language. Regularizers derived from what a model should preserve thus give principled continual-learning penalties.

items.title: Kernelized Parameter Sensitivity Atlases
items.summary: KPSA derives parameter-group sensitivity from a block decomposition of the empirical neural tangent kernel, measures it on a fixed source set, and estimates it for unseen inputs with a lightweight kernel. Kernel atlases amortize gradient attribution, a step toward scalable conditional interpretability.

items.title: Temporal Regularized Learning
items.summary: TeReL makes VICReg-style self-supervised learning local in space and time by pairing temporally adjacent inputs and replacing batch statistics with running estimates. The objective can thus be learned one sample at a time.

items.title: The Recursive Manifold Hypothesis
items.summary: The recursive manifold hypothesis states that real-world distributions are organized coarse-to-fine, with finer categories adding variation that remains organized within each parent. A model-free energy-distance test finds, in 13 of 14 image, text, and spiking-speech relation–representation pairs, finer variation that parent categories organize better than random groupings.

items.title: pptrain
items.summary: pptrain makes task-agnostic pretraining, on synthetic tasks chosen for structure that transfers, available as one installable workflow with six paper-derived task families and transfer evaluation.

items.title: Marey
items.summary: A plotting library for F# where the compiler checks your units, and the axes label themselves. Scales, SI prefixes, ticks, and axis titles are derived from unit witnesses, and the same figure renders to SVG, PNG, PDF, or LaTeX source.
